description: Foundation: refresh the iOS design tokens in src/app/globals.css and elevate the shared UI primitives to use them, so the iOS feel propagates app-wide. This feature is the base dependency for FEAT-002 and FEAT-003. Presentation only; no prop/signature/logic/copy changes; icons unchanged.
steps: In src/app/globals.css, tune the @theme block + the :root (light) and .dark CSS variables for a genuine iOS feel WITHOUT changing the structure or Tailwind v4 CSS-first conventions (@theme, @custom-variant dark, @utility safe-*): larger card corner radius (--radius-card ~1.5rem), softer/more-diffuse card and sheet shadows (--shadow-card, --shadow-sheet), a slightly cooler/greyer light --bg, and true near-black grouped dark surfaces tuned for correct contrast (--bg, --surface, --surface-2, --border for both :root and .dark). Keep the emerald brand tokens (--color-brand, --color-brand-fg, --color-brand-soft).

Add any NEW CSS variables / @theme tokens that later steps/features will reference (e.g. a control radius like --radius-control, a hairline border alpha, or a frosted-surface alpha for the floating tab bar) so primitives and the tab bar reference tokens rather than ad-hoc values. Keep the Apple system font stack already set on body.

Button (src/components/ui/Button.tsx): convert the rendered <button> to a motion.button from motion/react and add a subtle iOS press-scale via whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} with a gentle spring transition; keep all variants, props, types, min-height, rounded-pill, and classes otherwise intact. Note Button is currently a server component with no 'use client'; adding motion requires adding the 'use client' directive at the top.
Card (src/components/ui/Card.tsx): adopt the refreshed radius/shadow tokens (larger radius, softer shadow); keep the as-prop and className merge.
Segmented (src/components/ui/Segmented.tsx): keep the sliding selected-pill layoutId highlight; refine the spring and the selected/track colors to read as an iOS segmented control using tokens.
Sheet (src/components/ui/Sheet.tsx): keep the slide-up motion + grabber handle + tap-scrim; apply a gentle spring and the larger top corner radius from tokens.
Toast, ConfirmDialog, EmptyState, Stepper, Spinner (src/components/ui/*): align radii, colors, and spacing to the refreshed tokens; no behavior, prop, or copy changes.
Keep every file emoji-free (vitest no-emoji scan covers src incl. css comments). Do not import react-icons anywhere except the existing Icon.tsx; add no new IconKeys.
acceptance_criteria: src/app/globals.css still uses @theme + :root/.dark + @custom-variant dark + @utility safe-* (CSS-first conventions preserved) with retuned iOS values and keeps the emerald brand tokens.
Button renders with a motion/react whileTap press-scale and still exposes the same ButtonProps (variant, fullWidth, standard button attrs).
No shared primitive changed its public props, exported names, or behavior; only classes/tokens/animation polish changed.
No off-limits file (Icon.tsx, copy.ts, types, store, notifications.ts, pwa.ts, sw.ts, ReminderSettings.tsx) was modified.
`npm test` passes (155 tests incl. no-emoji scan) and `npm run build` succeeds.
verification: Run `npm test` and confirm all tests pass, including the no-emoji scan over src+css.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds (the pre-existing recommendation.ts ESLint warning is acceptable).
Run `git diff --name-only` and confirm no off-limits path is listed.
findings: New tokens available for FEAT-002/003 to reference instead of ad-hoc values: --radius-control (0.875rem) for control-sized corners; --radius-card is now 1.5rem (use rounded-card / rounded-t-card for sheets and cards); --frost / --color-... exposes a frosted-surface alpha (var(--frost): light rgba(255,255,255,0.72), dark rgba(28,28,30,0.72)) intended for the floating tab bar backdrop-blur; --hairline mirrors --border for hairline strokes. Light theme is now cooler/greyer (--bg #f2f3f5, --surface-2 #eceef1, --border #e2e5e9). Dark theme uses true-black grouped surfaces (--bg #000, --surface #1c1c1e, --surface-2 #2c2c2e, --border #38383a) matching iOS. Shadows (--shadow-card, --shadow-sheet) are softer/more diffuse. Emerald brand tokens unchanged. Tailwind v4 auto-generates utilities from @theme vars: rounded-control works; a frosted tab bar can use bg-[var(--frost)] + backdrop-blur. Button is now a client component (motion.button whileTap scale 0.97); its DOM onAnimationStart/onDrag handlers are cast away internally via HTMLMotionProps<"button"> but ButtonProps is unchanged. Segmented selected pill now uses rounded-[0.625rem] (not full pill) for the iOS segmented look. The two pre-existing ESLint warnings (notifications.ts _planLabel, recommendation.ts _exhaustive) remain and are expected. NOTE: the worktree also carries unrelated pre-existing uncommitted edits (layout.tsx, AppShell.tsx, ReminderSettings.tsx[OFF-LIMITS], plan.md, review.json, untracked Chrome.tsx) that were NOT touched by FEAT-001 and were left as-is; only the four FEAT-001 files + this JSON were committed.
